description:
The gate list an issue carries is exposed under three different names and shapes across machine-readable outputs, and one of them is the shape the storage reference documents. A consumer that follows the documentation and calls `jit issue show --json` asks for a key that is not there — and JSON answers with absence, not an error, so a wrong field name is indistinguishable from "this issue has no gates".

Observed while auditing gates across an epic: reading `gates_required` from `jit issue show --json` reported every issue as ungated. The audit looked clean and was wrong.

## The three shapes

| Surface | Shape |
| --- | --- |
| Stored record, `jit graph export --full`, `jit query --full` | `gates_required` (array of keys) + `gates_status` (map key -> status) |
| `jit issue show --json` | `gates` (array of `{key, status, exit_code, last_run_at}`) |
| `jit query` / `jit list` summaries | absent entirely |

`docs/reference/storage-format.md` documents `gates_required` / `gates_status` — the storage shape — because that is what the record holds. Nothing tells a reader that the single-issue command renames and reshapes it.

The failure mode is agent-facing: an agent that reads a field name from the reference, or that carries a field name across two commands, gets a silently empty result rather than a diagnosable error, and reports a false conclusion.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: One name and one shape for an issue's gates across every machine-readable output that carries them, or — if the summary and full projections must differ — the difference is declared in `jit --schema` so a consumer can discover it without reading the source.
- [hard] REQ-02: `jit --schema` documents the issue output shape each command emits, including which fields a summary projection omits, so a field absent from a response is attributable to the projection rather than to the data.
- [hard] REQ-03: Documentation that names these fields (`docs/reference/storage-format.md` and the generated references) agrees with what the commands emit; no page names a field a command does not return.
- [hard] REQ-04: Coverage asserts the emitted shape against the documented one, so a rename on either side fails the build rather than silently changing what consumers see.
title: Unify the machine-readable gate field across command outputs
